title: Expectation bounded by a maximizing value
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $f$ under $p$ is at most the value of $f$ at a maximizer of $f$ on $\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: A probability mass function on the sample space
A real-valued function on the sample space
